definitions.explanation: A product that does not meet quality standards due to a defect or flaw. Used in manufacturing, retail, and consumer contexts.

examples.japanese: {不良品|ふりょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{不良品|ふりょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{除|のぞ}いて→除く：02391_nozoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ship after removing the defective products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不良品|ふりょうひん}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The product I bought was defective, so I returned it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不良品|ふりょうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The factory conducts strict inspections to prevent defective products from occurring.

notes:
{不良品|ふりょうひん} is a product that fails to meet quality standards due to a manufacturing defect, damage, or malfunction. It is the standard term used in retail, manufacturing, and consumer complaint contexts when referring to items that need to be exchanged or returned.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧ (defective, bad) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (product, goods)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不良品|ふりょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to exchange a defective product)
- {不良品|ふりょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to return a defective product)
- {不良品|ふりょうひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (defective products appear/turn up)
- {不良品|ふりょうひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|ま}じる→混じる：02421_majiru⟧ (defective items get mixed in)
- {不良品|ふりょうひん}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (defect rate)

RELATED WORDS:
- {良品|りょうひん} (good-quality product)
- ⟦{欠陥|けっかん}→欠陥：02793_kekkan⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (defective product — more formal, often for serious flaws)
- ⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧ (returned product)
